translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Kuidi ngeyo Yave ndintambika muelꞌama.
Mu ngeyo ndintulanga diana diama, a Nzambi ama.
Kadi tala ti ndifuisu tsoni.
Bika bambeni ziama zibika ku ndunga.
Kadi mutu wumosi kalendi fua tsoni ko.
Vayi bela fuisu tsoni,
bobo bamvakulanga badiawu mu kambu phengomokono,
Bika wumbonisa zinzila ziaku, a Yave
bika wundonga minsolo miaku,
wundiatisa mu kiedika kiaku ayi wundongi.
Bika ngeyo Nzambi Mvulusi ama.
Ayi diana diama didi mu ngeyo mu lumbu kimvimba.
A Yave, tebukila kiadi kiaku kingolo moyo
ayi luzolo luaku lu ngolo,
bila bidi mu zithangu zioso.
Kadi tebukila moyo masumu mama ma kimuana ;
ayi kadi tebukila moyo zinzila ziama zi matingu.
Mu diambu di luzolo luaku,
bika wuthebukila moyo ;
bila ngeyo widi wumboti, a Yave.
Yave, widi wumboti ayi wusonga ;
diawu kanlongisilanga bankua masumu
mu zinzila ziandi.
Niandi wudiatisanga batu bakukikululanga mu mambu masonga ;
ayi wunlonganga nzilꞌandi kuidi bakukikululanga.
Zinzila zioso zi Yave zidi zi luzolo ayi zikuikama,
kuidi bawu beti keba zindombolo zi nguizani andi.
Mu diambu di dizina diaku, a Yave
bika wundemvukila mu mambimbi mama
bila madi mawombo.
Buna nani mutu wunkinzikanga Yave ?
Yave wela kunlonga nzila yoyi basobula mu diambu diandi.
Wela viokisa bilumbu biandi mu mamboti ;
ayi nkunꞌandi wela tambula tsi.
Yave weti monikisa mansueki mandi kuidi bobo bakunkinzikanga,
ayi weti kuba zabikisa nguizani andi.
Thalu ama yidi kuidi Yave
mu zithangu zioso.
Bila niandi wela totula malu mama mu dikondi.
Baluka kuidi minu
ayi bika nlemvo aku wuba va minu
bila ndidi minu veka ayi ndidi mu phasi.
Ziphasi zi ntimꞌama zilembo buelama ;
bika wuthotula mu ziphasi ziama.
Tala ziphasi ziama ayi kiadi kiama
ayi botula masumu mama moso.
Tala phila bambeni ziama zilembo buelimina
ayi bandendidi mu kikhenene kimosi kingolo.
Keba luzingu luama ayi khudi !
Kadi tala ti ndifua tsoni bila mu ngeyo ndisuamina.
Bika fuanana ayi lulama bikheba,
bila mu ngeyo ntudidi diana diama.
O Nzambi, kula Iseli mu ziphasi ziandi zioso.
